full_inspection: Compared all four native images in full, with enlarged math and final-line crops. Every original line and margin was inspected; ell and barred Q are the same typed shapes in both copies. The small final-line marks are recorded with uncertainty and no handwriting attribution.
original_transcription_comparison: Compared both full original transcriptions. Both originally label ell as hand, but the checked shape comparison corrects that classification. Distinct archive numbers and the overlooked uncertain copy2 baseline point are recorded below.

entries.decision: correct the copy2 original hand classification to typed, agreeing with the separately rechecked copy1 reading
entries.reason: Both scans have the same compact loop and terminals as the repeated typed-ell comparison; the original copy2 hand wrapper has no independent pen-contour evidence.

entries.decision: preserve a newly noticed copy2 baseline point as uncertain
entries.reason: The copy2 crop shows a small point at the baseline and a separate lower speck; copy1 lacks that baseline point. Textual origin remains unresolved.

entries.decision: retain both archive foliations without author attribution
